findings.description: F001 introduces human_not_yet_typed_pending for a required human family with no structured unavailable EvidenceRef, but the objective contract says each required consumer_family must carry its own honest availability=unavailable signal and that absence of such evidence is degraded_dishonest. This creates an unresolved semantic exception for missing human-family evidence before implementation locks.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether an untyped required human family is contractually pending or degraded_dishonest, then pin that rule in the completion tests so absence of structured human evidence cannot be interpreted differently by the checker.
